newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start mixed to lower, seen range trading.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start mixed to lower, seen range trading.

text.p: UK leading shares were mixed to easier at the start of proceedings on Tuesday following another weak performance by U.S. blue chips overnight.
The FTSE 100 is expected to trade in a narrow range during the morning session as investors await key U.S. economic data and Wall Street's open later this afternoon.
"It's pretty quiet. People aren't too interested in doing any business until we see these U.S. wage numbers," the head of trading at a major investment bank said.
The FTSE 100 index opened 5.6 points lower at 4,206.4. On Monday the Dow industrials closed 35.79 easier at 6,660.69.
